answer: Proof-of-burn timestamp registry: each identity burns 100 POA into a timestamped on-chain proof. The registry rejects a second identity from the same funding source within 24 hours, and the randomness beacon cross-checks each burn against the epoch seed so a pre-computed burn cannot be reused. Cloning 5,000 identities costs 500,000 POA plus beacon-mismatch risk per batch. Analogy: planting an orchard where each tree costs a marble of burn and the terrace of time limits how fast you can plant — each tree leaves a timestamped stone the beacon can read.
